verdict.rationale: Render's own site makes this exact claim: it keeps internal traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity. Its docs also reference 'private services', which can host internal workloads such as a ClickHouse instance. Separately, Render documents isolating non-production environments from production services. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how private networking works (internal hostnames, scope, region limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity

citations.quote: Keep internal traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity.
